mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE IS_API_DATA = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD ( USER_NO, TYPE_NO, BOARD_TITLE, NICKNAME, INTRODUCE, IMAGE_URL, URL, OPEN, IS_API_DATA, LIKES_COUNT, BOARD_DELETE, BOARD_POSTDATE ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{typeNo}, #{boardTitle}, #{nickname}, #{introduce}, #{imageUrl}, #{url}, #{open}, #{isApiData}, 0, 'N', NOW() )
INSERT INTO TAG (TYPE_NAME, DIFFICULT, COOK_TIME, CALORY, AI) VALUES (#{typeName}, #{difficult}, #{cookTime}, #{calory}, #{ai})
INSERT INTO INGREDIENT (SET_NO, INGREDIENT_NAME, QUANTITY, UNIT) VALUES (#{setNo}, #{ingredientName}, #{quantity}, #{unit})
INSERT INTO COOK_STEP (BOARD_NO, COOK_CONTENT, COOK_IMAGE, STEP) VALUES (#{boardNo}, #{cookContent}, #{cookImage}, #{step})
